facts.subject: Protected-main enforcement and review configuration
facts.claim: The repository has one direct human collaborator/owner and no repository teams; protected main requires strict up-to-date governance, quality, unit-coverage, CodeQL, and both Developer Portability OS check contexts, with administrator enforcement enabled. Required PR reviews, conversation-resolution enforcement, rulesets, and CODEOWNERS are not configured.
facts.source: GitHub REST collaborators, teams, branch-protection, required-status-checks, and repository-rulesets read-back for faresmohamed260/renderlab; expected settings are recorded in docs/governance/github-protection.json.
action_contexts: changing branch protection, required checks, review policy, or rulesets
using GitHub enforcement state as acceptance or governance evidence

facts.subject: Vercel production deployment and custom-domain cutover boundary
facts.claim: Automatic Git-to-Vercel deployment is disabled. Production uses the migrated RenderLab project. Production deployment, custom-domain cutover and rollback require explicit operator actions and independent provider read-back.
facts.source: Checked-in vercel.json and ADR-004, owner-authenticated Vercel deployment and alias read-back on 2026-11-22, and the independent production health response.
action_contexts: production deployment, custom-domain cutover, or rollback
changing Vercel project deployment or alias configuration
changing the Vercel plan or payment method to restore paused deployments
using the production application for a hosted acceptance checkpoint

facts.subject: Hosted Supabase Auth mail and leaked-password provider posture
facts.claim: The recorded Phase 10D audit observed the built-in Supabase Auth mailer/rate-limit posture and Free-plan leaked-password-protection limitation; those provider facts are not assumed current without re-verification.
facts.source: Configured Auth audit runs 33311990845 and 33312153080 plus hosted Supabase Security Advisor inspection recorded in INFRASTRUCTURE.md.
action_contexts: changing hosted Supabase Auth, SMTP, password-protection, or project-plan configuration

facts.subject: Direct production Modal cutover baseline and recovery anchors
facts.claim: The RenderLab FIBO production target is the Modal main environment in the approved modal-01 workspace. The renderer and gateway are deployed under the stable app IDs recorded in the release runbook. Modal can reschedule a Function input after a container crash or stop, so the bounded process-exit test targets its run-owned ComfyUI child.
facts.source: Modal app history and container read-back, Deploy FIBO Production Worker records, and the official Modal failures and container CLI documentation.
action_contexts: applying migration 0030 or creating dispatcher/worker credentials
stopping, deploying, rolling back, or retiring the production Modal gateway or image worker
injecting a production Modal worker-process or container failure
deploying or moving the Vercel production alias for the direct cutover

facts.subject: Reciprocal S.A.G.A. Modal ownership enforcement
facts.claim: S.A.G.A.'s protected main publishes the inverse Modal ownership manifest, and RenderLab's required Engineering Quality job performs a read-only live comparison that fails unless both repositories agree on a reciprocal, non-overlapping partition covering modal-01 through modal-47.
facts.source: Read-only protected-main fetch of faresmohamed260/saga config/modal-project-ownership.json by scripts/verify-modal-cross-repo-ownership.mjs, plus GitHub protected-main read-back.
action_contexts: changing RenderLab or S.A.G.A. Modal account ownership
mutating Modal credentials, fleet-management workflows, worker deployment, reset, or provisioning boundaries

facts.subject: Current disaster-recovery provider capability and independence limits
facts.claim: The retained-recovery evidence is repository-managed logical Supabase recovery rather than managed PITR/full-project recovery, and the R2 recovery destination is same-provider/same-account protection; published RPO/RTO still requires repeated scheduled evidence.
facts.source: ENT-007 Recovery Drill run 37630554797 and the Supabase/R2 provider read-back recorded by the recovery runbook.
action_contexts: real disaster recovery or restored-data cutover
publishing recovery objectives or changing provider/plan/retention assumptions
